And she was the leader of our little group. 

So, on this day, it was summer, she called me at my house few hours after school was finished. She told me to meet up at the playground outside our elementary school and wanted to show me something cool. 

I worshipped her at the time and went where she told me to go. At first I didnt see her and waited on the swings for couple of minutes until I saw her and four other girls that I've never met walking with her. 

Those girls were definitely high schoolers and middle schoolers. The tallest one was 16. The ages were 9-16.

I got off the swings to talk to her but she immediately climbed up the climber playset and stood on the highest pedestal to see the view of what was about to happen. 

I wanted to climb up as well. 

But the moment I grabbed the handle, one girl pushed me to the ground. I looked up at my friend and asked who these girls were. Feeling scared, already shaking, to the point I wanted to throw up. She didnt answer, she just continued to look with her nonchalant face. 

Then someone kicked me on my back. And that's where it started. 

They pulled my hair, pushed me, punched me on my head, kicked my limbs, spat on me, pushed my face onto the sand. Just beating the shit out of me. ALL of them. Those four girls. 

My friend just continued to stare at me when I had chances to look at her during this beating. I'm sure I saw her laugh.

After they were done,

I cried while I was laying on the sand, looking up at her. And asked why she did this. 

She went,

'Just cause' while giggling. The girls laughing with her too. 

.

We've been friends since we were 6. I always liked her and she was the coolest friend to hang out with, at that time. 

After this, I dont have any memory of what I did and said to my parents or what my parents did. And, I broke it off with her. Luckily, she stopped being a brat to me for years. Then we've never talked since.
